content:
OpenSearch Service limits Java processes memory to 50% of total available memory(max upto 32
GiB). The upper limit of 32 GB doesn't apply to r7g and OpenSearch optimized instances.
To request limit increase, contact AWS Support.
Advanced users can also specify the percentage of the heap used for ﬁeld data. For more
information, see Advanced cluster settings and JVM OutOfMemoryError.
